blocks.text: Since 2014, we have been pleased to offer a program tailored to meet the needs of our youngest Wildcats! What began as one Pre-K4 classroom has now grown to include nine classrooms spanning Pre-K3 through Kindergarten. Our team includes a group of talented professionals, passionate about Early Childhood, serving in the roles of teachers, aides, fine arts specialists, and more.
Our days are filled with learning opportunities from the moment our Cubs enter the classroom. Students are greeted each day with meaningfully designed activities and interactions.

Each teacher follows a play-based curriculum, incorporating appropriate learning standards into intentionally prepared lessons, hands-on activities, and invitations to play. Students eat lunch in their classrooms each day and participate in two outdoor recesses, alongside their similarly aged peers.

Our primary objective in the preschool program is to incorporate and promote our Student Core Values as a means of developing an early love of learning and a passion for the Word of God. Students are given the opportunity to experience these values through grade-level service projects, our weekly Preschool Chapel experience, and through the collaborative nature of our curriculum and classroom environment.
